summary.tldr: Lowers the Criminal Code threshold for criminal interest rates and counts insurance charges in the interest calculation, while repealing the payday loan section.
what_it_does: Raises the point at which an interest rate becomes criminal, from 35 percentage points above the Bank of Canada overnight rate to 30 percentage points above it.
Adds insurance charges and other similar charges to the definition of interest when calculating the rate on credit.
Keeps other charges and expenses in the interest calculation, even if they are called fees, fines, penalties, commissions or similar charges.
Repeals section 347.1 of the Criminal Code, which deals with payday loan agreements.
summary.background: The bill amends the Criminal Code rules on criminal rates of interest.
